name: petvet-web
description: A static frontend clone of the Petvet theme, built using vanilla HTML/CSS and Bootstrap 5 for the Saylani Mass IT Training Batch 7 final exam.

paragraphs: Petvet is a static single-page website for a pet veterinary and grooming service. It is built using vanilla HTML5 and CSS3, leveraging Bootstrap 5.3.8 for responsive layout components and Font Awesome 7.0.1 for icons.
This project was built as the Final Exam for HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and styling libraries for the Saylani Mass IT Training's Techno Kids Course (Batch 7).
The design and layout of this project are inspired by and cloned from the Colorlib Petvet Theme.
features: CSS3 - Custom styles with CSS variables
Bootstrap 5.3.8 (CDN) - Grid system, navbar, carousel, cards, forms
